simple.meaning: עָלָה (ʻâlâh) appears 894 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, beginning at Genesis 2:6. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, offering, altar, kingship, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָלָה (H5927) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עָלָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עָלָה (ʻâlâh) / H5927 is tracked through Genesis 2:6, Genesis 8:20, Genesis 13:1, Genesis 17:22. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: to ascend , intransitively (be high ) or actively ( mount ); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
definitions.usage: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, × mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.
